 A.I. Corning beat profit expectations on AI demand for fiber-optic materials
 Core sales rose 19% to $5.08 billion as the optical communications unit grew 44%, and Corning forecast fourth-quarter core EPS of $0.96 to $1.00
 By Cris Tolomia · 2 min read · Updated October 27, 2026 Add QZ to Google Cheng Xin / Getty Images
 Corning reported third-quarter core earnings of 91 cents a share on Tuesday, up 36% from a year earlier, as sales in its Optical Communications segment rose 44% to $2.38 billion. Core sales, a non-GAAP measure, grew 19% and reached $5.08 billion, the company said.
 The core earnings figure topped the 88 cents a share analysts expected, according to The Wall Street Journal . The average analyst estimate was 89 cents, according to The Associated Press . Core sales also beat the $5.03 billion analysts expected, according to The Wall Street Journal and The Associated Press.
 Sales of generative AI products grew more than 100% from a year earlier, and sales in the Enterprise Networks business grew 84%, the company said. Net income in the Optical Communications segment rose 80% to $532 million.
 "Faster adoption of our innovations helped us double our Gen AI sales year over year in the quarter, outpacing GPU unit growth," Chairman, CEO and President Wendell P. Weeks said in a statement.
 On a GAAP basis, net income attributable to Corning climbed 58% to $680 million, or 78 cents per share, compared with $430 million, or 50 cents per share, in the same quarter last year. GAAP sales increased 18%, reaching $4.86 billion. Core operating margin expanded 310 basis points to 22.7%, and adjusted free cash flow was $661 million.
 Solar sales grew 37% as production kept scaling up, though the climb was slower than the company had expected. Corning also secured four long-term, multibillion-dollar customer agreements in the quarter, including with Verizon $VZ and AT&T $T , the company said.
 For the fourth quarter, Corning expects core sales of $5.2 billion to $5.3 billion, up about 19% from a year earlier. It expects core earnings of 96 cents to $1.00 a share, up about 36%. The earnings range is above the 93 cents a share analysts expected, according to The Wall Street Journal.
